title: Choosing the knife and the cut

items.stem: You want to peel an apple and cut out its core by hand. Which knife fits this small, close-in job best?

items.stem: A recipe says to cut a zucchini into 1/2-inch cubes so the pieces cook evenly. Which cut is that?

options.text: A julienne, which is a thin stick
A slice, which is a flat piece
